notes.name: Foundry MCP Server v0.8.6
notes.body:
## Foundry MCP Server v0.8.6

Complete multi-platform distribution for Foundry MCP Server - AI-powered campaign management for Foundry VTT using Claude Desktop.

**Compatible with Foundry VTT v13 and v14.**

### Installation Options

**Windows Users:**
- Download `FoundryMCPServer-Setup-v0.8.6.exe`
- Run installer (no admin rights required)
- Automatic Claude Desktop configuration

**Mac Users:**
- Download `FoundryMCPServer-v0.8.6.dmg`
- Open DMG and double-click the PKG installer
- Choose components: MCP Server (required), Foundry Module, ComfyUI AI Maps
- Automatic Claude Desktop configuration
- To uninstall: Double-click `Uninstall.tool` from the DMG

**Manual Installation (All Platforms):**
- Download `foundry-mcp-server-v0.8.6.zip`
- Extract and run with Node.js 18+
- Manual Claude Desktop configuration required

**Foundry VTT Users:**
- Install directly from Foundry's module browser
- Or use manifest: `https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/releases/latest/download/module.json`

### Quick Start
1. Choose your installation method above
2. Install MCP Bridge module in Foundry VTT
3. Restart Claude Desktop
4. Start creating AI-powered campaigns!

### New in this release
- `create-chat-message`: NPCs can speak in-character lines as speech bubbles, chat-log messages or whispers
- DSA5: import characters from Dark Aid, Optolith-style or custom JSON exports
- PF2e: the condition tools work again, and conditions are applied properly
- dnd5e: removing a condition no longer deletes a larger effect that includes it, such as Paralyzed
- The creature index now includes compendiums with non-Latin names, and the dnd5e size filter works
- The Windows installer now configures Claude Desktop in third-party mode (AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI)

See the changelog for the full list.

### Features
- 50 MCP tools for comprehensive Foundry VTT integration
- Multi-system support: D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e, DSA5, Cosmere RPG, WFRP4e, and Mongoose Traveller 2e
- Generic actor CRUD (create/update/delete actors and embedded items) across all systems
- D&D 5e NPC creation suite: stat blocks, attacks, saves, auras, and spellcasting
- Actor creation with natural language processing
- Quest management with HTML generation and updates
- Campaign system with multi-part structure and progress tracking
- Dice roll coordination between Claude and Foundry players
- Actor ownership management with bulk operations
- Enhanced creature index for instant monster searches
- AI-powered battlemap generation with ComfyUI integration

For full documentation, visit: https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp


## What's Changed
* feat(dsa5): add Dark Aid character JSON importer by @frankyh75 in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/92
* docs: bring tool count and list to 49 after the DSA5 importer by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/123
* feat: add create-chat-message tool for in-character lines/chat messages by @tacostorm in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/114
* docs: bring tool count and list to 50 after create-chat-message by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/128
* Fix: index packs with non-Latin1 labels; fix dnd5e size filter by @GoDsqF in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/127
* fix(installer): also configure Claude Desktop's third-party mode folder by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/129
* fix(conditions): toggle conditions through the system's own API by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/130
* chore(release): prepare v0.8.6 by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/131

## New Contributors
* @GoDsqF made their first contribution in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/127

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/compare/v0.8.5...v0.8.6
